references.text: The instruction to bake unleavened bread, unleavened cakes mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers spread with oil for the consecration ceremony of the priests.
Moses takes one unleavened cake, one cake with oil, and one wafer from the basket and places them in Aaron's and his sons' hands as a wave offering.
Description of unleavened cakes mixed with oil and unleavened wafers spread with oil as part of the grain offering.
Unleavened cakes mixed with oil, unleavened wafers spread with oil, and cakes made from fine flour as part of the thank offering.
The preceding verse describing the fat and the right thigh on which the unleavened bread was placed.
A basket containing unleavened bread, cakes of fine flour mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers spread with oil at the consecration of a Nazirite.
The priest takes a boiled shoulder, one unleavened cake, and one unleavened wafer from the basket and places them in the hands of the Nazirite.
